packages.label: מַלְכוּת וּתְפִלָּה
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share the essential nature of Malkhut — divine kingship — in its various expressions across Torah 49. The Torah's central thesis is that prayer is the manifestation of Malkhut within the chalal panui of the heart (§ב: 'תפלה בחינת מלכות'). Malkhut David is the epitome of holy kingship-as-song ('ואני תפלה'; 'נעים זמירות ישראל'). Shemen (anointing oil) IS Malkhut David — the oil of anointment that enacts kingship. The small/diminished Malkhut ('מלכות בשפלות ובקטנות') — expressed as 'אחות לנו קטנה', 'את המאור הקטן', and 'אתתך גוצא' — is the same Malkhut in its unrectified exile state (the small moon, the humbled wife). Malkhut Peh (mouth-Malkhut) = Kevod Elokim (divine glory), because when Malkhut ascends to the 'aifah' (where-is-the-place-of-His-glory), that IS Malkhut-as-speech. 'Isha yirat H'' IS the Eitza — the humble Malkhut in its counsel-state is the same small-Malkhut-as-good-advice domain. All nodes are aspects of the same ontological concept: Malkhut as holy kingship/prayer/song in its multiple states.
merge_notes: Four raw connected components were merged into this package by shared nature (never by eitza):
Component A (5 nodes): {תפלה, מלכות, מלכות דוד, שמן, נעים זמירות ישראל} — the core Malkhut-as-prayer-and-song cluster, connected via edges 1836, 1864, 1865, 2111.

Component B (4 nodes): {מלכות, בשפלות ובקטנות; 'אחות לנו קטנה'; 'את המאור הקטן'; אתתך גוצא} — Malkhut in its small/diminished state, connected via edges 2, 13, 489. Merged by shared nature: this IS the same Malkhut as Component A but in its unrectified state. Torah 49 §ה explicitly teaches that the Dalet (small-Malkhut) and the He (rectified-Malkhut) are the same letter-concept at different stages. The small moon, the humbled wife, and the small sister are all faces of the same Malkhut.

Component C (2 nodes): {מלכות פה, כבוד אלהים} — Malkhut Peh = Kevod Elokim, from §ז (edge 1449). Merged by shared nature: Malkhut Peh is explicitly an aspect of Malkhut (the 'mouth' of divine sovereignty); Kevod Elokim is what Malkhut IS when elevated ('כד איהי סליקית'). This 2-node component shares the essential Malkhut nature.

Component D (2 nodes): {'אשה יראת ה'', עצה} — the God-fearing woman IS the Eitza (edge 2428). Merged by shared nature: Torah 49 §ה directly equates 'אשה יראת ה'' with 'בחינת מלכות בשפלות — אתתך גוצא', and the proof-text for edge 489 explicitly contains 'אתתך גוצא' as a synonym. The God-fearing woman-as-advice IS the small-Malkhut in its role as the humble counselor. Same essential nature as Component B.

Tie-breaking for dominant node: both מלכות דוד and מלכות, בשפלות ובקטנות have degree 3. מלכות דוד is chosen as dominant because it is the aspirational realization of Malkhut in this Torah — the explicit telos of the teaching (§ה: 'מלכות דוד = שיר'). The small-Malkhut is the starting state; Malkhut David is the goal state.

packages.label: תְּכֵלֶת וְכַּלָּה וּמַקִּיפִים
packages.label_en: Tekhelet, the Kallah, and the Encompassing Lights
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share the essential nature of tekhelet — the divine blue-force of encompassing light that simultaneously destroys the klipa-nations and sustains Israel. Torah 49 §ז teaches that tzitzit IS tekhelet IS makifim — the surrounding encompassing light. The tekhelet 'consumes all and destroys all' (din/gevarot) yet Israel who clings to it remain alive. Kallah IS tekhelet (she who destroys all; 'כלה' and 'כלה בחמה' share the same root). Nefesh David IS tekhelet (the driving consuming passion of David's soul). Ruach Tzafon = din/gevarot = tekhelet — the north wind that awakened David's lyre came from the same din-force that is tekhelet. Mincha = din (Yitzhak established Mincha-prayer which IS din). All nodes are expressions of the same consuming, encompassing divine-force-of-din that is tekhelet/makifim — the holy outer light that overwhelms and destroys evil.
merge_notes: This package is a single raw connected component (no merges needed). All 8 nodes connect through tekhelet (degree 5) as the hub: tzitzit-tekhelet (3131), kallah-tekhelet (3129), nefesh-David-tekhelet (3130), din-tekhelet (3128), tekhelet-makifim (1933). The din sub-cluster connects through edges 731 (mincha-din) and 732 (ruach-tzafon-din), which links into the tekhelet cluster via edge 3128 (din-tekhelet).

Note on polarity: din and gevarot are often neutral or evil, but in Torah 49 they appear exclusively in the holy context of tekhelet's protective-destructive force. The Rebbe explicitly states that this tekhelet 'consumes all' but 'Israel who clings to it live' (§ז). The din here is the holy din of Malkhut deKedusha that annihilates Malkhut deSitra Achra. Polarity is therefore 'good'.

packages.label: שִׁיר וְאוֹת דָּלֶ"ת
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share the essential nature of the future divine Song (שיר שיתעורר לעתיד) in its structural dimension, as taught in Torah 49 §ה. The Dalet letter IS the vessel of the fourfold song (shir pashut, kaful, meshulash, meruva) — the Dalet's four sides/corners are the structural container for the four levels of song. Dalet kenafot (the four wings/corners of the earth = mikkenaf ha'aretz) IS the Dalet letter's cosmic expression. Sarah (the matriarch whose name means 'ruling') IS Song — 'שרה = שיר' because the singing of holy rule is how Malkhut is revealed ('שרה על כל העולם = שיר'). The core shir (song, simple) is a separate node from 'shir pashut kaful' etc., but both are manifestations of the same essential category: the song that accompanies and reveals Malkhut. The Dalet nodes cluster around the letter's structural role as the vessel of song and its cosmic extension (four corners of earth).
merge_notes: Two raw connected components merged by shared nature:

Component A (4 nodes): {אות דל"ת, דלת כנפות, מכנף הארץ, שיר פשוט כפול משלש מרבע} — connected via edges 749 (dalet→dalet-kenafot), 1807 (dalet-kenafot→mikkenaf-ha'aretz), 2874 (dalet→shir-pashut-etc.).
Component B (2 nodes): {שרה, שיר} — connected via edge 2873 (sarah→shir). This is a small (2-node) component eligible for merging.

Merge basis (shared nature, not eitza): Both components belong to the same domain of 'the future Song as revealed through/by Malkhut.' Torah 49 §ה explicitly teaches these in the same passage: שרה = שיר = וְשָׁרִים כְּחוֹלְלִים (the singing of divine rule), and Dalet = the structural container of shir pashut/kaful/meshulash/meruva. Sarah-as-song and Dalet-as-song are two faces of the same song-domain — one via the feminine-ruling name (שרה → שיר as verbal parallel), the other via the letter structure. Both belong to the song-of-Malkhut-revelation domain. Note: the שיר in edge 2873 (node2) and the שיר פשוט כפול משלש מרבע in edge 2874 (node2) are distinct node_ids and are kept separate in the node list.

packages.label: יוּ"ד וּקְדֻשָּׁה וַעֲשָׂרָה נִגּוּנִים
packages.label_en: The Letter Yud, Holiness, and the Ten Types of Melody
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of the Yud letter as the vessel of kedusha and the ten types of niggun. Torah 49 §ג and §ה teach that the Yud drawn into the Dalet transforms it into He. The Yud = kedusha (because 'there is no kedusha except with ten' — Megillah 23a; Yud = ten = minyan = kedusha). The Yud = ten types of melody (עשרה מיני נגונא) — the Yud's numerical value of 10 maps directly to the ten song-types. Together, the Yud embodies the concentrated, point-force of holiness (kedusha as the essential point, as the ten-fold generative power) that generates the fullness of song when combined with the Dalet vessel. These three nodes are all faces of the same single concept: the Yud in its role as the point of concentrated kedusha/niggun.
merge_notes: Single raw connected component — no merges needed. Edges: 2461 (yud→esarah-mini-niguna), 2602 (yud→kedusha).

This package stands independently (3 nodes, above the merge threshold). The Yud cluster is conceptually related to Package 3 (Song/Dalet) because Torah 49 §ה explicitly states 'He = Dalet + Yud' and the full song = Dalet + Yud combined. However, since Package 4 has 3 nodes (not a 'small' 1-2 node component) and both packages represent distinct sub-aspects of the letter He (the Dalet dimension vs. the Yud dimension), they are kept separate to preserve structural granularity. Their relationship is eitza-like (the two combine to form He), not bechina of shared nature.

packages.label: שַׁבָּת וּתְשׁוּבָה
packages.reason: All nodes share the essential nature of teshuva and the future Shabbat-rest as the vessel for the revealed Torah de-Atika. Torah 49 §ו teaches that Shabbat IS teshuva ('וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד ה' = שַׁבָּת = תְּשׁוּבָה'). 'Mashivat nefesh' (the restoring/returning of the soul, from the verse about Torah) IS Shabbat — because the restoration of the soul through Torah IS the Shabbat rest ('כי בו שָׁבַת וַיִּנָּפַשׁ'). Great teshuva that 'reaches the Throne of Glory' is the same as the revelation of Oraiyta de-Atika — the future Torah of the Ancient One — which is the essence of Shabbat. All three nodes are expressions of the same reality: the return/rest that reaches beyond the present world into the depth of Ein Sof, which is what Shabbat and Teshuva both ultimately point to.
merge_notes: Single raw connected component — no merges needed. Edges: 3247 (shabbat→teshuva), null-id edge (mashivat-nefesh→shabbat).

Note: The null-id edge for 'משיבת נפש — שבת' was included in the dataset without an assigned ID. It is a valid bechina edge with explicit proof-text ('מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ, זֶה בְּחִינַת שַׁבָּת, כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת וַיִּנָּפַשׁ') from §ו/Torah text line 81.

The small moon, the humbled wife, and the small sister are all expressions of Malkhut. Torah 49 teaches throughout that the Dalet (small-Malkhut) and the realized Malkhut are the same ontological concept at different stages. Shared nature confirmed.

Malkhut Peh is an explicit sub-aspect of Malkhut (the speech/mouth dimension of divine sovereignty). Kevod Elokim IS Malkhut ascended ('אי פה' = where Malkhut goes when elevated). Both nodes are expressions of the Malkhut domain. 2-node small component merged.

'אשה יראת ה'' IS the eitza-aspect of the small Malkhut. Torah 49 §ה equates this with 'אתתך גוצא' = Malkhut in humility, which is already in Component B (merged). Same essential nature: the small-Malkhut as feminine guide/counsel. 2-node small component merged.

שרה = שיר is part of the same §ה teaching about the future Song as revealed through Malkhut ruling. Both Component 4 (Dalet = structural-song) and Component 5 (Sarah = song-through-ruling) are aspects of the same 'song domain' in Torah 49. 2-node small component merged by shared nature.
